summary: Replay the remaining ADR 0371 service verification wrappers from the latest realistic origin/main base, finish the fresh-worktree generator repairs, and re-verify repowise, litellm, and librechat directly on the live platform.

verification.observed: `uv run --with pytest --with pyyaml --with jsonschema --with jinja2 python -m pytest -q tests/test_ansible_execution_scopes.py tests/test_canonical_truth.py tests/test_common_docker_bridge_chains_helper.py tests/test_docker_runtime_role.py tests/test_environment_topology.py tests/test_generate_cross_cutting_artifacts.py tests/test_generate_platform_vars.py tests/test_generate_release_notes.py tests/test_live_apply_worktree_bootstrap.py tests/test_litellm_runtime_role.py tests/test_livekit_runtime_role.py tests/test_ollama_runtime_role.py tests/test_openbao_compose_env_helper.py tests/test_ops_portal.py tests/test_packaged_repo_paths.py tests/test_plausible_runtime_role.py tests/test_repowise_playbook.py tests/test_restic_config_backup.py tests/test_runtime_general_service_playbooks.py tests/test_service_compose_macro_resolution.py tests/test_service_live_apply_wrappers.py tests/test_subdomain_catalog.py tests/test_subdomain_exposure_audit.py tests/test_uptime_kuma_runtime_role.py tests/test_validate_portal_auth.py tests/test_validation_toolkit.py` passed with `250 passed in 39.66s`.

verification.check: Repowise exact-main replay and public health verification
verification.observed: The governed `service=repowise` replay completed on docker-runtime, the container reported healthy locally, and `https://repowise.example.com/health` returned `HTTP 200` with the Repowise JSON health payload after startup stabilized.

verification.check: LiteLLM exact-main replay and private liveliness verification
verification.observed: The governed `service=litellm` replay completed successfully across proxmox-host, postgres, and docker-runtime, including the Docker bridge-chain and guest-firewall checks. Direct verification returned `HTTP 200` and `"I'm alive!"` from `http://10.10.10.20:4000/health/liveliness`.

verification.check: LibreChat exact-main replay and public edge verification
verification.observed: The governed `service=librechat` replay completed successfully across proxmox-host, coolify, and nginx, and `https://chat.example.com/` returned `HTTP 200` with the LibreChat HTML shell.

notes: The latest realistic base for the exact-main replay was origin/main@7b72694975ef8aae83e59d96c08dd27181595b2e with repo version 0.178.142 and platform version 0.178.141.

The first 2026-04-11 scoped litellm replay preserved the historical proxmox_network ifreload/SSH failure, but the 2026-04-14 exact-main replay did not reproduce it because the host network render was already converged and the reload path stayed skipped.

The governed replay transcripts reached clean play recaps for litellm and librechat before their optional controller-side shell footers stalled; direct verification was rerun immediately and recorded separately so the live state remains fully evidenced.
